I recommend sending one last email to confirm a specific payment date with the company. From your screenshots, it seems there might be a delay, possibly because they think you’re being lenient.

Politely ask them to complete the payment by [date]. If they can’t meet that deadline, let them know you may need to apply interest on the outstanding amount based on the rate from their salary bank.

You might also consider filing a complaint with the district (where the company is registered) or the city’s MOLISA (Ministry of Labour, War Invalids and Social Affairs). They can assist you in sorting this out. Wishing you the best of luck!
